constraints: THE COMMITTED HARNESS IS THE OBJECT OF MEASUREMENT AND IS NEVER MODIFIED. Do not edit, patch, monkey-patch in a way that persists, or `fix` anything under harness/. NEVER CALL harness.endomorphism_la.main(), in process or as a subprocess. It raises IndexError at endomorphism_la.py:451 whenever B mod 3 != 0 with relations present, which is true of seven of the fourteen declared cells, and it computes quantities this probe is forbidden to compute.

include_phi_orbits IS FALSE AT EVERY _collect_relations CALL, WITHOUT EXCEPTION. Record the value actually passed, per call, in supply_probe.json. A single call with it True invalidates the whole probe and must be reported as such.

COMPUTE NO CLOSURE, NO ALPHA, NO PHI_ALPHA, NO DISPLACEMENT RANK, NO MISALIGNMENT SET, NO PREDICTED SET, NO rank_M, NO RANK DEFICIENCY, NO BRANCH DETERMINATION, NO F-1 TO F-5 VERDICT, NO LADDER STATEMENT, NO SCALING LAW AND NO COST QUANTITY OF ANY KIND. If you find yourself writing a permutation of a row, you have exceeded this card.

THE WALL-CLOCK AND MEMORY FIGURES YOU RECORD ARE BUDGET ACCOUNTING, NOT COST QUANTITIES. Record them per part and per cell in distinct non-overlapping windows, and state in probe_manifest.json that they are budget accounting and are not a cost measurement, a comparison or a baseline.

COMPUTE EVERY INSTANCE PARAMETER; TRANSCRIBE NONE. p, n, a, b, zeta3, curve_id and the derived seed are computed from the committed generator and recorded. NO instance parameter may be hardcoded, transcribed from a report, or supplied on the command line. A MISMATCH AGAINST A PRIOR RECORD IS A FINDING TO REPORT, never a defect to fix and never grounds for overriding the computed value.

RECOMPUTE R_base(B) = (B + 2) // 3 + 1 AND Q(B) = max(60, B + 10) FROM THE FORMULAS, per cell, and compare against the table in this queue's the_probe_specification.PART_B_SUPPLY_RT35_CTRL_2.cells. REPORT ANY DISAGREEMENT AS A FINDING and adopt NEITHER side silently.

THE DISTINCT-TARGET COUNT IS MEASURED, NOT SUBSTITUTED. Report it as measured from the targets the committed loop actually visited in that call. You may quote the TASK-20260729-043 pre-flight's derived bounds of 183 for CURVE-J12S1 and 3468 for CURVE-J16S3 BESIDE it, labelled as derived bounds from that receipt, and a disagreement IS A FINDING TO REPORT.

REPORT SETS, NOT BARE COUNTS (PRED-ID-STR). On a PART A condition-(ii) failure, emit the FULL SORTED LIST OF FAILING (j, k) PAIRS with the offending values - never a count alone. Where you report a count, say it is a count and give its generating rule. A cardinality agreement with a different member set is `cardinality_only_agreement` and is NOT reported as agreement.

EVALUATE THE PRE-REGISTERED FALSIFICATION CONDITION MECHANICALLY AND INTERPRET IT NOT AT ALL. Record `falsification_condition_fired` as true or false in probe_manifest.json, computed by exactly this rule and no other: it fires if len(F) != B at B = 192 or at B = 193, OR if max(0, R_base(B) - len(relations)) >= 2 at any (cell, arm). NAME every contributing cell and arm. WRITE NO INTERPRETATION, NO RECOMMENDATION AND NO DISPOSITION - those belong to the reviews and to the Coordinator.

A TIMED-OUT, CANCELLED OR FAILED CELL IS NOT A SHORTFALL AND IS NOT FED TO THE FALSIFICATION CONDITION IN EITHER DIRECTION. Record it with terminal status `failed_infrastructure` or `cancelled_by_budget`, valid false, and the invalid_reason. THAT IS INFRASTRUCTURE SIGNAL AND IS NEVER A NEGATIVE MATHEMATICAL RESULT (AGENTS.md core rule 5).

DETERMINISM CHECK: re-execute the two smallest cells - L12 and A12M3, both arms - a second time in the same process and record a determinism PASS or FAIL with the compared values. A FAIL is a FINDING TO REPORT and invalidates the affected cells, not the whole probe.

RUN THE PRE-FLIGHT DISK CHECK BEFORE THE FIRST WRITE and record the exact free-space figure in probe_manifest.json. IF FREE SPACE IS BELOW 5 GiB, STOP AND REPORT AND WRITE NO PROBE ARTIFACTS. The volume was reported at 99 percent with about 30 GiB free and git fsck has already timed out on it.

A BREACH TERMINATES THAT UNIT AND IS RECORDED AS INFRASTRUCTURE SIGNAL with the terminal status recorded - NEVER as a measurement, NEVER as a zero, NEVER as a shortfall and NEVER as a negative result about anything. Execution continues with the remaining cells after a per-unit breach. On a TOTAL-cap breach, record every unstarted cell as `cancelled_by_budget` and STOP AND REPORT A BOUNDED PARTIAL RESULT NAMING EXACTLY WHICH CELLS AND ARMS YOU DID NOT REACH.

ARTIFACT-SIZE CAPS: 2 MiB per file, 8 MiB for the whole probe directory. ON A PER-FILE CAP: write the sha256 of the offending structure, OMIT the full dump, record DEV-SIZE-1 NAMING THE EXACT CELLS AND ARMS, and continue - NEVER write a truncated JSON document. ON THE TREE CAP: STOP and report which named cells were not reached.
WRITE ALL EIGHT DECLARED FILES EVEN FOR A PARTIAL, CANCELLED OR FAILED PROBE, with the terminal status recorded in probe_manifest.json. That is what makes the nine-path archive declaration exact.

CREATE NO RUN IDENTIFIER, WRITE NOTHING UNDER experiments/, AND DO NOT CALL harness.runner.write_run. This probe is not an experiment run and must not be archived as one (INT-BATCH015-F). Record probe_manifest.json's `run_ids` as an empty list WITH the reason stated.
